text.title: Single Page Case Study Generation — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the case-study report: a named or anonymised publication version (or a written refusal logged), delivery, draft and publish-or-park dates inside the 7-day and 14-day windows, an outcome-first title carrying the headline number, the six slots in order (problem 1-2 sentences, approach 2-3 sentences naming the stack, outcome 1 sentence, numbers as baseline, final, delta, unit, window and source system, a verbatim pull-quote with written permission, the NDA indicator), a 500-word cap with at most one chart, an anonymisation block when the client is not named, inputs_used pointing at the stored evidence and permission, exactly one tracked discovery-call CTA, and a 90-day outcome review. Validator at scripts/validate-single-page-case-study-generation.py enforces it, including the date windows, the delta arithmetic, sentence counts, evidence references and the review date.

required.field: named, anonymised, or internal_log_only after a written refusal of both (r-nda-fallback-never-drop)

`delivery_date`, `draft_date` within 7 days of delivery, `publish_or_park_date` within 14 days, `status` published or parked with `park_reason` and `revisit_date` when parked (r-seven-day-draft-fourteen-day-publish)
outcome first, with the headline number and the time frame; never the service or the freelancer first (r-outcome-first-headline)

`problem` {text, sentences 1-2}, `approach` {text, sentences 2-3, stack_or_method}, `outcome` {text, sentences 1}, `numbers[]` each {metric, baseline, final, unit, delta_pct, window, source_system, evidence_ref}, `pull_quote` {text, contact_name, contact_role, company or company_descriptor, permission_captured_in, permission_ref}, `nda_indicator` (r-six-slots-on-one-page, r-numbers-baseline-final-delta, r-evidence-source-named-and-kept, r-pull-quote-verbatim-with-written-permission)
whole document, at most 500 and at least the words in the slots (r-six-slots-on-one-page)
stored evidence exports and the permission message, each {name, path}; every `evidence_ref` and `permission_ref` names one of them (r-evidence-source-named-and-kept)
`count` 1, `target` discovery_call, `url` with a utm or tracking parameter (r-single-cta-tracked-to-discovery-call)
`due_date` 90 days after publication; `findings` null until held, then `discovery_calls_attributed` and `included_in_closed_proposal` (r-single-cta-tracked-to-discovery-call)

forbidden.pattern: a number without `baseline`, `final`, `unit` and `window`, a `delta_pct` that is not (final - baseline) / baseline, or the words significant, dramatic or huge in the outcome slot — fm-01-vague-results
a pull-quote with no `contact_role`, no `permission_ref`, or text that paraphrases ("the client was very happy") — fm-02-paraphrased-praise
`publication_version` internal_log_only without a written refusal reference, or an anonymised version with a client name or logo — fm-03-nda-means-no-study
`draft_date` more than 7 days after delivery, `publish_or_park_date` more than 14 days after, or a study started more than 30 days after delivery — fm-04-written-up-six-months-later
`word_count` above 500, `media_count` above 1, a missing slot, or sentence counts outside the slot's range — fm-05-two-page-feature-list
`cta.count` other than 1, a `url` without a tracking parameter, or an `outcome_review.due_date` that is not 90 days after publication — fm-06-untracked-asset
an `evidence_ref` or `permission_ref` that names nothing in `inputs_used` (r-evidence-source-named-and-kept)
a `title` with no number, or one that leads with the service or the freelancer (r-outcome-first-headline)

example.note: Drafted 5 days and published 12 days after delivery; the title leads with the outcome and its number; both numbers carry baseline, final, unit, window and the system they were read from, and 560 against 1,480 is minus 62.2 percent; the quote is a verbatim sentence from a named VP with an email permission stored under inputs_used; one tracked CTA and a review due 90 days after publication.

Drafted five months after delivery; a service-first title with no number; a four-sentence problem and a one-sentence approach with no stack; "significant improvement" as the outcome; a number with no baseline, no unit, no window and no system; paraphrased praise with no contact name, no role and verbal permission; 900 words and three screenshots; no evidence stored; three CTAs to a contact page; a review nine months out.

list.item: `draft_date` is within 7 days of `delivery_date` and `publish_or_park_date` within 14; a parked study carries a reason and a revisit date.

The title leads with the outcome and carries the headline number; the six slots are present in order with the sentence counts the rule sets; `word_count` is at most 500 and covers the slot texts; at most one chart.
Every number has baseline, final, unit, window and source system, `delta_pct` = (final - baseline) / baseline x 100, and its `evidence_ref` names an entry in `inputs_used`.
The pull-quote is verbatim, from a named person (or a role and descriptor when anonymised), with `permission_ref` stored in `inputs_used`.
An anonymised version has industry, size band, context, quoted role, the client's consent reference and no identifiers; a named version has a contact name and company.
Exactly one CTA to a tracked discovery-call URL; `outcome_review.due_date` is 90 days after publication.
